en.affiliation: Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
en.intro: Nanopore single-molecule sensing, bioanalysis, and medical engineering.
en.summary: Engineering nanopores with the PIToN model, repeatedly measuring individual molecules, and interpreting sensing mechanisms with molecular dynamics and finite-element simulation.

directions.title: Nanopore Sensing
directions.description: PIToN-guided aerolysin engineering for protein citrullination; nanopore assays for glycans, sialic-acid linkage isomers, and cisplatin–DNA adducts.

directions.title: Single-Molecule Manipulation
directions.description: Solid-state nanopore devices, molecular ping-pong control, and repeated capture for multiple measurements of the same molecule.

directions.title: Mechanistic Studies
directions.description: Molecular dynamics and finite-element simulation to interpret pore–molecule interactions, molecular transport, and ionic-current signals.

zh.affiliation: 中国科学院大连化学物理研究所
zh.intro: 纳米孔单分子检测 · 生物分析 · 医工交叉
zh.summary: 以 PIToN 模型指导纳米孔工程化，发展同一分子的重复测量，并结合分子动力学与有限元模拟解析检测机制。

directions.title: Nanopore Sensing
directions.label: 纳米孔传感
directions.description: 以 PIToN 模型指导瓜氨酸化检测的纳米孔工程化，并发展中性糖链、唾液酸连接异构体及顺铂–DNA 加合物分析。

directions.title: Single-Molecule Manipulation
directions.label: 单分子操控
directions.description: 研制固态纳米孔器件，通过分子乒乓操控与重复捕获，对同一分子进行多次测量。

directions.title: Mechanistic Studies
directions.label: 机制研究
directions.description: 结合分子动力学与有限元模拟，解析孔道–分子相互作用、分子输运及离子电流信号之间的关系。
